written.headline: Jensen Huang allies form "war room" to lobby for his return as Nvidia CEO
written.summary: A group of Silicon Valley executives is assembling a "war room" to lobby Nvidia's board to reinstate Jensen Huang as CEO, days after he resigned over reports of affairs with a subordinate and a suspected Chinese spy. The public letter demanding his return has gathered over 150,000 signatures, with support from Elon Musk and Tim Sweeney.

written.headline: Corma raises $125 million Series A to scale AI agents for cyber defense
written.summary: Corma, a Tel‑Aviv and San Francisco startup that builds custom‑trained AI agents for defensive cybersecurity, closed a $125 million Series A led by NEA, bringing total funding to $185 million and valuing it at $1 billion.

written.headline: OpenAI launches computer-use agents and plugins for healthcare teams
written.summary: OpenAI announced new computer-use agents that can operate across healthcare software, along with improved clinical answer capabilities and new healthcare plugins. The tools are intended to help healthcare teams get real work done.
